main_sampler.description: GRAFT on frozen ELF-B: R=4 partial generations from fresh noise to the read time, each committing up to m=8 rare words (strongest rare candidate with probability above qmin=0.08 but not the top choice, attestation and language gates), then a final full trajectory with all commitments held in place; atomic commitment, splicing, word-boundary co-pinning and anti-repetition correction at lambda=0.5; stock ELF sampler otherwise

study.venue_line_text: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027

credited_component.text: identify a lexical long-tail collapse in continuous dLLMs

design.other_detail: D10 other: GRAFT read-and-restart; each round is abandoned at the read time and generation restarts from fresh noise with the committed rare words held in place from the first step; splicing re-decodes the position after a commitment at output. D11 other: the set of committed words is carried across rounds and into the final generation. D15 other: denoising head trained with MSE (x-prediction) plus a decoding head trained with token-level cross-entropy through a shared unembedding.

census.F2_detail: G: GRAFT holds committed rare words in place as hard constraints through every denoising step (R=4 rounds, up to m=8 words per round, candidate probability above qmin=0.08, attestation and language gates) and applies the anti-repetition correction at lambda=0.5 at each step. NS: the base token rule of the stock ELF sampler (temperature, truncation) for the Table 2 runs is not stated; the final readout is the decoding head.
